none: PAS NLM-68CC81: Roman Coin: Copy or Forgery of Denarius of Severus Alexander
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver or Base Silver. Coin. Possibly a Copy or Forged Denarius of Severus Alexander (222-235), issue of 226 by mint of Rome if not copied, pierced at 9 O'clock on obverse, Reece period 12. Obverse description: Bust draped and laureate right. Obverse inscription: IMP[--]MAVR SE[V ALEXAND] AVG. Reverse description: Annona standing left holding corn ears and cornucopiae with modius at her feet.…
